notes: Web Package 899 / sos-cache-v899. Realtime performance: P2P transfer flow control, voice P2P E2EE, call relay health failover and ring latency. Secure incoming-call receiver starts on identity readiness (no outgoing-call priming). Security closure: mesh relay signals are recipient-bound P2pSecureV2 ciphertext only; outgoing call signaling is kind 1059 only (no 25050 downgrade on policy failure). First-group network-backed administration (israel-network). Group control panel behind a 6-digit admin PIN lock with server-side Admin 2FA (server PIN verifier + attestation signer; enforcement ships OFF until owner enrollment). User-centric group control UX (search, per-user role and permissions; saving disabled until the control plane is activated). Admin 2FA enforcement ON with the pinned production signer; root-only Gate 1.5 activation (attested genesis, no grants). Gate 2: owner-activated admission service delegation (single FINALIZE_MEMBERSHIP_ADMISSION capability, Admin 2FA attested). Gate 4: accessControlV2Scope (FULL | CONTROL_PLANE); CONTROL_PLANE keeps member content, P2P and the single-network UI as V2 off. ACCESS_CONTROL_V2 ships OFF. 899h: top-bar invite reconciles authority before the capability check (INVITE_USERS propagation); Worker-identity recovery via sealed F5B6-W handoff to the isolated signer and F5B5 reveal; truthful onboarding (no fake key field/buttons); logout/switch guarded until the recovery backup is confirmed. 899i: account creation includes the personal key — after Passkey the isolated signer saves SOS-personal-key-<fingerprint>.txt locally and returns only a non-secret completion (PERSONAL_KEY_EXPORTED); login accepts the key file. 899j: profile metadata is actually published (awaited typed signature, relay acks, monotonic created_at), avatar/cover stored as durable Blossom https URLs, profile page loads the signer; one newest-wins profile resolution for feed, conversations, public profile and group management (stub names are refreshed); the floating home group-management button is removed (menu entry only). 899k: per-user permission panel shows three primary permissions (הזמנת חברים, מחיקת פוסטים ותגובות, ניהול חברים) with short explanations; the other canonical capabilities are in a collapsed advanced section (UI only, protocol unchanged). 899l: MANAGE_MEMBERS description matches its effect (remove members and manage their membership state, no permission changes); pending joins are read-only with an automatic-approval status (no dead manual approve button; admission stays with the Admission Service). Multi-community network deferred. MD4 not started. Android/APK frozen.
